Comment: VOD Process stage (native integrations, no Lambda): a child of the Orchestrator state machine. Select the probed VIDEO track height, choose the sd|hd|uhd tier (with optional metadata override), submit a single static-CMAF (HLS+DASH) Automated-ABR MediaConvert job via createJob.sync, and record outputs + playback URLs in DynamoDB. Its state is returned as Output for the orchestrator to forward to Publish. The MediaConvert account endpoint ${MEDIACONVERT_ENDPOINT} is resolved automatically by the optimized createJob.sync integration, so it is not passed as a Task parameter. On any failure it ends in the Fail state, which propagates the error/cause to the orchestrator's Catch.

Extract Video Metadata.Comment: MediaConvert Probe does not guarantee the video track is first in Tracks[] (e.g. audio-first MP4s list audio at index 0), so a fixed Tracks[0] path can miss the video. Select the track whose TrackType is 'video' and normalize its height into $.videoHeight; the tier Choice reads $.videoHeight so it works regardless of track order. When no video track is present the field is absent, routing to Unsupported Source.

Check Video Track.Comment: Only proceed for probe results that contain a decodable video track (height normalized by Extract Video Metadata).

Unsupported Source.Comment: Set an error object for the Fail state (and, in turn, the orchestrator) when the upload has no probeable video track.

Parameters.Cause: The uploaded object does not contain a probeable video track.

Choose Tier.Comment: Map source to a quality tier by probed height - SD below 720 (e.g. 480/576), HD from 720 up to 1080 (< 1440), UHD at 1440 and above (the Default). Three static per-tier templates are kept so each can carry a tier-appropriate maxAbrBitrate / max-resolution ceiling. (FUTURE - 'per-title encoding': a per-asset tier/ladder selection driven by source metadata, replacing the removed stack-wide tierOverride switch.)

Encode SD.Comment: Submit the SD MediaConvert job and block to completion via the optimized createJob.sync integration. The JOB_SETTINGS_SD placeholder is replaced at synth time with the full sd MediaConvert Settings object (single CMAF HLS+DASH output group, Automated ABR, QVBR + MULTI_PASS_HQ; video + audio only - captions are a deferred opt-in overlay); that injected object carries the runtime FileInput (source URI) and CMAF Destination (s3://.../<guid>/index) reference paths.

Encode HD.Comment: Submit the HD MediaConvert job (createJob.sync). The JOB_SETTINGS_HD placeholder is the injected hd Settings object (see Encode SD).

Encode UHD.Comment: Submit the UHD MediaConvert job (createJob.sync). The JOB_SETTINGS_UHD placeholder is the injected uhd Settings object (see Encode SD).

Build Playback URLs.Comment: Derive the CloudFront HLS/DASH playback URLs and the S3-relative manifest keys from the deterministic destination (s3://<dest>/<guid>/index). No GetJob call and no Lambda are needed - the destination naming is a contract with the injected JOB_SETTINGS_* Settings object (CMAF base name 'index'). Passes toggles and identifiers forward to Publish.

Record Job.Comment: Update the DynamoDB job record with encode outputs and playback URLs via the native integration (no Lambda). Keyed on the guid partition key.

Parameters.UpdateExpression: SET workflowStatus = :s, srcHeight = :h, tier = :tr, encodeJobId = :j, hlsUrl = :hls, dashUrl = :dash, hlsManifest = :hlsm, dashManifest = :dashm

Process Failed.Comment: Propagate the specific error/cause to the orchestrator's Catch (which owns the single Error record + SNS notification). ErrorPath/CausePath surface the dynamic $.error set by the failing state.
